# Project Guidelines

## Privacy and Sensitive Information

- Never write personal or identifying information, user-specific device or hardware specifications, confidential project details, unpublished creative content, credentials, or secrets into tracked files, documentation, examples, tests, logs, commit messages, or issue text.
- Use generic placeholders and non-sensitive synthetic data. Refer to environment-variable names when documenting configuration; never include their values.
- Before finishing a change, check touched files for prohibited information and remove any occurrences. Keep generic privacy and security guidance that does not reveal actual user or project data.
